technique_name: Write a blog post about the pros and cons of replacing boring lectures with interactive presentations.
description:
In a world where technology is changing the way we learn, the idea of replacing boring lectures with interactive presentations is gaining traction. But is this actually a good idea? In this blog post, I’ll be discussing the pros and cons of using interactive presentations in the classroom.

Let’s start with the pros. An interactive presentation can be much more engaging for students than a boring lecture. It gets them out of their seats and allows them to be part of the learning process. Student
